objective: Salvage the valid inductive lifting implication and derive necessary conditions on a smallest nonempty root counterexample, without assuming the false partition-existence assertion.

atomic_claims.text: A monosource of a genuine uniform quotient lifts from an internal monosource of its source part; no two-colour quotient premise is needed.
Induced parts and genuine uniform quotients inherit absence of rainbow directed triangles.
A smallest nonempty root counterexample, if one exists, has no proper nonsingleton colour-direction module.
A smallest nonempty root counterexample is strongly connected.
Every nonempty tournament of order at most four with no rainbow directed triangle has a monosource.
A smallest nonempty root counterexample must be strongly connected, colour-direction-module-free, and have order at least five.

assumptions: Finite simple tournaments; nonempty parts and singleton parts allowed.
Only finite-digraph-basic and finite-combinatorics are used.
Auxiliary statements are explicitly restricted to nonempty tournaments; the contract is not edited.
Minimal-counterexample conclusions are conditional on existence within the three-colour class.
risks: Natural-language candidate, without a matching trusted mathematical receipt.
No programmatic tournament enumeration or proof-assistant run was performed.
The root statement and all admitted records remain unchanged.
This is an auxiliary repair-audit proof candidate, not a proof of universal partition existence or of the root.
No novelty or complete prior-art coverage is claimed.
